stories.title: Prove /land folds and pushes one commit server-side, no caller git
stories.scope: Live check `node porting/tests/land-hardening.probe.mjs` (scratch chain only: REST-fork demo → demo-lh-base → agent-lh-1; never lands into `demo`, never touches agent-1..4; deletes both scratch repos on exit). Seams: platform/src/index.ts `handleLand` (POST /land — reviewed stale gate → single computeMerge fold → pushLand), platform/src/land.ts `pushLand` (one git.commit at :84-90 with message ``land(${input.repos.join(",")}): fold proposal(s)``, one git.push at :100-105 over the v1 wire, token minted in-worker). Contract: platform/CONTRACT.md §POST /land (folds in order, pushes ONE commit, no caller clones). Precondition: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or a live wrangler OAuth token (`wrangler whoami` refreshes; precedent porting/runs/land-hardening/verify.md).
stories.acceptance: `node porting/tests/land-hardening.probe.mjs` exits 0 with every assertion PASS. (a) /land returns HTTP 200 {ok:true, landed:{repos,commit,files,at}} and `evidence.commit === landed.commit`; the base repo's remote refs/heads/main equals evidence.commit — the fold+push happened server-side, with no clone and no CLI on the caller's side; the pushed commit is the single commit pushLand creates with message `land(<repos>): fold proposal(s)` (one git.commit → one git.push). Supporting assertions in the same run: (b) re-land with refreshed reviewed heads → 409 no-changes; (c) stale reviewed heads → 409 stale (proposal-head and base-head variants) with the base unmoved by refusals; (d) concurrent double-land → exactly one 200 + one 409 base-moved; (e) both scratch repos deleted at exit.
stories.check_cmd: node --check porting/tests/land-hardening.probe.mjs && grep -Fq 'fold proposal(s)' platform/src/land.ts && (node porting/tests/land-hardening.probe.mjs || (sleep 10 && node porting/tests/land-hardening.probe.mjs) || (sleep 30 && node porting/tests/land-hardening.probe.mjs))
stories.notes: Not a rebuild — verification of the shipped (deployed) landing path; no product code changes. Overlapping store rows, not recreated: land-hardening [done], landing-path-land-folds-proposals-onto-the-baseline-server-s [done], let-humans-land-the-chosen-proposal-from-the-canvas [done]. FR-16/FR-17 server preconditions (stale/base-moved) are E3-impl implementation scope; the probe asserts them inside the same green run rather than a separate story. The pending rows landing-evidence-receipt-tested-sha-equals-merged-sha-record (tested↔merged receipt persistence), attach-signed-validation-evidence-to-every-change (SLSA-style signed attestations), speculative-validation-of-the-fold-result-before-landing-dem and validate-every-proposal-with-speculative-execution (speculative execution) are future/out-of-scope work — none recreated here; this story proves the evidence object the shipped /land returns. The probe is network-bound: transient `TypeError: fetch failed` / SSL EOF flakes were observed 2026-10-06 under concurrent-agent load; the two retries encode the order's own re-run precedent (porting/runs/land-hardening/verify.md attempts 1→4). Scratch-only and safe to re-run; a green transcript is at porting/runs/land-hardening/verify.md (06:43Z run).

stories.title: Prove /land needs no caller credentials and leaks no token
stories.scope: Token lifecycle seams: platform/src/land.ts `mintWriteToken` (repo-scoped write token, TTL 300 s) and platform/src/index.ts `handleLand` finally (`baseRepo.revokeToken(token)` — revoked whether the push landed or failed). Live read-only refusal: POST /land with an impossible reviewed head (agent-1 → 40×0) returns 409 stale before any fold — nothing pushed, base unmoved (precedent: land-hardening probe assertion (c) `base unmoved by refusals`).
stories.acceptance: A live POST /land with an impossible reviewed head (agent-1 → 40×0) returns 409 {ok:false, error:"stale", detail:…} whose exact top-level key set is {detail, error, ok} — no token or credential field anywhere in the envelope (jq assertion, run green by the author on 2026-10-06). The push token is worker-minted and never handed to the caller: `mintWriteToken` (platform/src/land.ts) + `revokeToken` in the handler's finally (platform/src/index.ts) are the only token seams; the /land success body {ok, landed, evidence} carries no credential and the caller sends none (probe transcript of E3-verify-server-side-land-one-commit).
stories.check_cmd: curl -sS --retry 2 --retry-all-errors --max-time 60 -X POST https://nextgit-platform.john-b7d.workers.dev/land -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"base":"demo","repos":["agent-1"],"reviewed":{"heads":{"agent-1":"0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"}}}' | jq -ec '(.ok == false) and (.error == "stale") and ((keys | sort) == ["detail","error","ok"])' && grep -Fq 'mintWriteToken' platform/src/land.ts && grep -Fq 'revokeToken' platform/src/index.ts
stories.notes: Read-only: the reviewed-state gate refuses before fold/push, so the curl retry (--retry-all-errors covers transport flake; safe to re-send a refused request) cannot double-land anything. Success-path token absence is evidenced by the sibling story's probe transcript (same executable); this story adds the mechanical envelope assertion and the mint/revoke seams. Not a rebuild.

stories.title: Prove card confirm → landing… two-step and the in-flight banner copy
stories.scope: platform/ui/app.js action-state machine: `data-action="start-land"` sets state.confirmingRepo → inline `confirm land?` + `cancel`; `data-action="confirm-land"` → handleLandProposal (the only branch that POSTs /land); `data-action="cancel-land"` reverts; state.landingRepo renders a single disabled `landing...` button (:572-591). Click dispatch: setupInteractions (:951-987). Warn banner copy in handleLandProposal (:879-883). Deployed asset: https://nextgit-platform.john-b7d.workers.dev/app.js (single environment).
stories.acceptance: FR-15 outcomes 1–2, exact copy: `Land into demo` → the card flips to inline `confirm land?` + `cancel` (no dialog — start-land only sets state and re-renders; confirm-land is the sole branch that calls handleLandProposal). `confirm land?` → the card shows a single disabled `landing...` button and the action banner (warn) reads "Landing proposal {repo} into {base}...". Asserted on the repo asset (node --check + fixed-string greps incl. the three data-action hooks) and on the deployed /app.js the browser loads. Browser-level DOM rendering is not machine-checkable here (no browser harness in the repo; manual browser confirmation recorded in docs/STATE.md) — asset + dispatch-hook + deployed-asset evidence is the available proof.

stories.title: Prove withheld-secret, conflict, and generic failure banners
stories.scope: platform/ui/app.js handleLandProposal catch branches (:912-945): 409 withheld-secret → "Withheld-secret file — landing blocked ({files})."; 409 conflict → "Conflicted files: {files}. (preview merge first)"; any other failure → "Failed to land {repo}: {msg}"; finally → state.landingRepo = null (card returns to default). Dismissal wiring: el.actionBannerClose → hideActionBanner (:1027-1029; no auto-hide). Deployed asset + repo asset.
stories.acceptance: FR-15 outcomes 4, 5, 7, exact copy: 409 withheld-secret → error banner "Withheld-secret file — landing blocked ({files})."; 409 conflict → error banner "Conflicted files: {files}. (preview merge first)"; any other failure → error banner "Failed to land {repo}: {msg}". Every failure returns the card to default (state.landingRepo cleared in the finally → re-render); the banner persists until dismissed (dismiss button wired to hideActionBanner; no auto-hide timer). Asserted on repo asset + deployed /app.js. Deliberately NOT asserted: outcome 6's dedicated no-changes copy and the withheld-secret/conflict card states — E3-impl build gaps.

stories.title: Prove landed card dims 0.55/dashed and renders nothing-pending copy
stories.scope: platform/ui/app.js renderProposals isLanded (:523-524 landing.status === "landed" with fallback stats.files === 0; :573-576 `landed` badge; :593 is-landed class; :611-616 landed banner copy). platform/ui/styles.css .proposal-card.is-landed (opacity 0.55, border-style dashed). Server side: platform/src/index.ts computeProposals (:594-610) folds each proposal alone onto the current base head → landing {status: ready|conflict|landed|withheld-secret, files}; zero-change fold → landed; /land zero changes → 409 no-changes (probe (b)).
stories.acceptance: FR-19 as built: a proposal with landing.status === "landed" (or stats.files === 0) renders the card dimmed — .proposal-card.is-landed opacity 0.55 + dashed border — with the `landed` badge and the line "landed — nothing pending" ("All changes from this branch have been merged into baseline."), asserted on repo asset + deployed /app.js. landing.status is content-derived server-side: live GET /proposals carries a landing object per proposal whose status ∈ {ready, conflict, landed, withheld-secret} (jq assertion, run green by the author 2026-10-06); a zero-change fold is `landed` and /land with zero changes is 409 no-changes — never a fake success (no-changes leg proven in E3-verify-server-side-land-one-commit).
